key_facts: she had peeped into the book her sister was reading
a White Rabbit with pink eyes ran close by her
the Rabbit actually took a watch out of its waistcoat-pocket
she ran across the field after it
to see it pop down a large rabbit-hole under the hedge
The rabbit-hole went straight on like a tunnel for some way
noticed that they were filled with cupboards and book-shelves
it was labelled “ORANGE MARMALADE”, but to her great disappointment it was empty

forbidden_claims.claim: The White Rabbit peeked into Alice's storybook before hurrying past her.
The jar Alice found on the shelf was full of orange juice.
Alice waited three days before following the Rabbit into the hole.

notes: Curly quotes around the marmalade label; a named White Rabbit vs. Alice's unnamed sister tests name-candidate grounding.
